svg.title: A 30-Day Sprint to an Execution-Ready Brokerage
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: A 30-Day Sprint to an Execution-Ready Brokerage; subtitle: Build evidence and operating readiness before forecasting collected residuals.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The four milestones span Days 1–30. Activities use authorized project resources and customer-provided records. Partner onboarding, renewal timing, and vendor activation can extend beyond this sprint; the canonical first-deal range is 1–3 months.; caption: Finish the sprint with a defined niche, verified economics, executable documents, and a reconciled pilot or documented activation schedule. Do not label quoted savings, unsigned rebates, or future residuals as recognized revenue.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Choose one niche and verify partner routes; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Select a repeatable buyer segment, obtain current partner terms, define excluded license arrangements, and build a retained-revenue worksheet separating subscription principal from operator consideration.; label: Days 8-14; value: Collect evidence and test comparable economics; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Request permissioned renewal contracts, normalize product scope, test vendor price floors, and calculate prospective shared-savings fees. Document why each candidate passes or fails the four pre-commitment checks.; label: Days 15-21; value: Execute mandates and establish funded readiness; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Finalize compensation terms, member rebate allocation, customer authority, and permitted transfer steps. Verify funding before annual commitments and configure distributor or master-agent statement reconciliation.; label: Days 22-30; value: Reconcile a pilot and schedule remaining activation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Complete one authorized pilot when vendor timing permits, or record the dated activation dependency. Reconcile earned consideration, inspect exception handling, and compare forecast contribution with the Base-Case cost structure.

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Collect evidence and test comparable economics; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Request permissioned renewal contracts, normalize product scope, test vendor price floors, and calculate prospective shared-savings fees. Document why each candidate passes or fails the four pre-commitment checks.

Verify funding before annual commitments and configure distributor or master-agent statement reconciliation.

text.title: Execute mandates and establish funded readiness

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Reconcile a pilot and schedule remaining activation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Complete one authorized pilot when vendor timing permits, or record the dated activation dependency. Reconcile earned consideration, inspect exception handling, and compare forecast contribution with the Base-Case cost structure.

text.title: Reconcile a pilot and schedule remaining activation

Assumptions: The four milestones span Days 1–30. Activities use authorized project resources and customer-provided records. Partner onboarding, renewal timing, and vendor activation can extend beyond this sprint; the canonical first-deal range is 1–3 months.
